conversationData.topic: First, I got an open fireplace set up. My measurement-devices measured the fire at 180°C
Afterwards, I mixed together a pound of prey in a bowl, with two to four ping pong balls and some greens.
I also added the powder of anger, a secure-spicer, a cromch of bread, and a hacked sadness-spreader.
The ingredients then were mixed and rolled into small balls and put onto a baking plate.

chat.message: Why were the balls required?
Balls were required because the recipe for Yummy Webby Things with Flesh and Yum Yum Sauce specified rolling ingredients into small balls before baking.

conversationData.topic: I put the small balls into the fireplace for 20 to 30 minutes, until brown.

No, I discarded them, they aren't necessary for the dish.
